Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word.

Death : Accident :: Starvation : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Death is caused by an Accident.

Similarly,

Starvation is caused by a hunger strike.

Hence, "option 1" is the correct answer.

questions.question: Select the option in which the words share the same relationship as that shared by the given set of words (in the same order). Hand : Finger : Ring
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option in which the words share the same relationship as that shared by the given set of words (in the same order).

Hand : Finger : Ring
questions.solution:
Fingers are part of a hand and rings are for fingers

Hence, the order is Hand : Finger : Ring

Similarly, Nose is part is a face and nose pin is for nose.

Hence, option 1 is correct.

questions.question: Select the option in which the words share the same relationship as that shared by the given pair of words. Temple : Worship
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option in which the words share the same relationship as that shared by the given pair of words.

Temple : Worship
questions.solution:
Temple is a holy place of worship.

Similarly,

Option 1 → President is the highest position in the university.

Option 2 → Garden is a place where plants are found.

Option 3 → Church is a holy place for prayer.

Option 4 → Golden Temple is a holy place of worship in Amritsar.

‘Church: prayer’ share the same relationship as that shared by the given pair of words.

Hence, “church: prayer” is the correct answer.

questions.question: Words given on the left side of ( ∶∶ ) are related with each other by some Logic/Rule /Relation. Select the missing word/word pair on the right side of ( ∶∶ ) from the given alternatives based on the same Logic/Rule/Relation. Wall ∶ Brick ∶∶ Sack ∶ ?
questions.questionHtml:
Words given on the left side of (∶∶) are related with each other by some Logic/Rule /Relation. Select the missing word/word pair on the right side of (∶∶) from the given alternatives based on the same Logic/Rule/Relation.

Wall ∶ Brick ∶∶ Sack ∶ ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Wall ∶ Brick → The wall is made up of bricks.

Similarly, 

Sack ∶ Jute → The sack is commonly made of jute.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question: Select the word-pair in which the two words are related in the same way as are the two words in the following word-pair. Doctor : Cardiologist
questions.questionHtml:
Select the word-pair in which the two words are related in the same way as are the two words in the following word-pair.

Doctor : Cardiologist
questions.solution:
The logic is:

Doctor : Cardiologist → Cardiologist is a Doctor who specializes in the study or treatment of heart diseases and heart abnormalities.

Similarly,

Engineer : Chemical Engineer → A Chemical Engineer is an Engineer who possesses chemical and mechanical knowledge, and who applies that knowledge to the utilisation, on a manufacturing scale, of chemical action.

Hence, ‘Engineer : Chemical Engineer’ is the correct answer.
